summary: Plan for slice 010 completed and committed (7d9f346); task shape is cross-cutting. It has seven phases: P1 ArgoCDDeploy (webhook secret in the hook environment, namespace grant removed), P2 HelmCharts (reconciler-aware orphan audit that never lists an Argo-owned release as an uninstall candidate), P3-P5 KubeCoderDeploy (chart on homelab-shared with stage config and render gate; the seven Build-Main pins; Terraform for the ZFS PV plus the dev-owned webhook), P6 the KubeCoder manifest line, and P7 the diff-preview procedure in the Argo runbook. verification.json has 24 outcome-level criteria mapped 1:1 to R1-R15 and the rulings; the close-out holds three operator outstanding actions and one suggestion for slice 012.
